### Deflating Pride
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-february-25-2013.html
Passage: Isaiah 51:1
Points:
- Believers are urged to reflect on the pit from which they were cut.
- Taking an honest look at our humble origins deflates self-importance.
- Remembering what Christ saved us from keeps everyone level as recipients of grace.
- Even celebrated biblical figures like Moses, Peter, and Rahab had fallen pasts.

### Power for the Impossible
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/power-impossible
Passage: Isaiah 51:2
Points:
- God encouraged the discouraged remnant of Israel by pointing them to Abraham and Sarah.
- The exiles felt small and powerless against overwhelming odds in a ruined land.
- God proved His ability to do the impossible by multiplying one solitary man into a nation.
- Recalling God's past covenant faithfulness gives believers courage when they feel forgotten.
- The remnant's trust in God's promises found its ultimate fulfillment in Christ.
